assets.name: Credentials and restricted diagnostics
assets.objective: never reach browser, fixture, telemetry, or audit

assets.name: Workflow lifecycle and configuration rails
assets.objective: typed bounded evolution without customer code or policy bypass

assets.name: Maintenance scorecard and control integrity
assets.objective: measured low toil without suppression or misclassification

assets.name: Human sponsorship, agent attribution, personal-brain isolation, and capability separation
assets.objective: correct partner context without impersonation, cross-brain disclosure, or authority widening

trust_boundaries.rule: typed request reference and safe status projection; no cookie or business payload reuse
read-only start; exact principal, capability, resources, environment, plan hash, and expiry
typed plan-bound invocation only; browser never invokes
source, observed_at, expiry, classification, and schema validation
server redaction and allow-listed fields before serialization

trust_boundaries.to: repository, broker, event, audit, export, and model context
trust_boundaries.rule: server derives and immutably binds tenant and environment before authorization
allow-listed typed data only; no code, SQL, commands, customer executable workflow, actuator registration, or platform-policy bypass

trust_boundaries.from: authenticated runtime and verified grant metadata
trust_boundaries.to: standing-context rule selection, capability broker, and audit
trust_boundaries.rule: server separately derives tenant, sponsor, agent, runtime, brain scope/version/count, and capability; missing or conflicting scope fails visibly

threats.abuse_case: A Workspace, Deal Room, or MCP credential is presented to an operations route.
mitigations: dedicated origin, audience, and cookie namespace
wrong audience returns 401 without resource disclosure

threats.abuse_case: An attacker sets ?profile=joe or supplies actor, role, risk, environment, or capability fields.
mitigations: default deny when no exact grant matches

threats.abuse_case: An agent approves its own plan or grants itself a production capability.
mitigations: human approver identity differs from executor
agent grants contain no approve or grant capability

threats.abuse_case: An approval for an earlier revision is used after a material plan change.
mitigations: material change creates a revision and invalidates approval

threats.abuse_case: A valid capability for rehearsal/service A is applied to production/service B.
mitigations: exact resource and environment grant match

threats.threat: Prompt or output injection becomes authority
threats.abuse_case: Collector text or agent output embeds instructions that a router executes.
mitigations: no arbitrary command or generic MCP route
capability derives only from server policy

threats.abuse_case: A DSN, token, private key, raw client record, or unrestricted diagnostic reaches fixtures, DOM, telemetry, or audit.

threats.threat: Stale or missing evidence displayed as Healthy
threats.abuse_case: A cached successful check survives collector failure and is rendered as current health.
mitigations: stale or missing required input forces Unknown

threats.abuse_case: A refreshed browser retries or completes a server operation based on cached UI state.

threats.threat: Capability inheritance by replacement agent session
threats.abuse_case: A new task or executor inherits an old task's production grant.
mitigations: capability binds one session and expires
replacement session requires a new grant

threats.abuse_case: Events are reordered, edited, deleted, or linked across different plans so execution cannot be proven.

threats.threat: Business record leakage into operations plane
threats.abuse_case: Client payload or transcript content is copied into an operations work request or audit event.

threats.threat: Cross-tenant confused deputy or object replay
threats.abuse_case: A valid foreign tenant ID, cursor, object, workflow, approval, or capability is replayed through a CARR session, audit query, export, model context, or Workspace return.
mitigations: mandatory exact predicates at every repository and projection surface
synthetic cross-tenant fixture across eight exact denial paths covering ten tenant-scoped resource classes

threats.threat: Customer or tenant admin captures platform control
threats.abuse_case: A licensed corporate seat or tenant-local administrator gains platform code, IP, provisioning, licensing, release, or platform-policy authority.
mitigations: separate platform and tenant administration capabilities
no public signup, provisioning, billing, invite, or customer platform-admin flow

threats.threat: Tenant configuration, trial, or under-evidenced promotion becomes executable infrastructure or a competing authority
threats.abuse_case: A tenant supplies code, SQL, script, command, executable customer workflow, actuator, or risk-policy override through a flexible field; a trial creates a new source of truth, destructive migration, parallel writer, or generic workflow engine; or pilot-to-approved or approved-to-standard promotion omits evidence, immutable version, owner, observation window, failure handling, rollback, adoption test, or cutover gate.
mitigations: generic workflow engine, plugin marketplace, and customer scripting excluded from the current program

threats.threat: Low-toil metric gaming or unsafe automation
threats.abuse_case: A control, alert, refusal, or failure is suppressed, normal work is mislabeled as exception, alerts are over-deduplicated, or automation claims completion without verified outcome to hit the maintenance target.
mitigations: measured minutes and separately attributed exceptions
verification, visible refusal, and named remedy

threats.threat: Runtime principal is mistaken for sponsoring human
threats.abuse_case: A Joe-sponsored Codex session uses codex as the personal scope, returns a misleading successful zero, and omits Joe's active personal rules.
mitigations: separate immutable sponsor and agent fields
derive personal brain only from verified sponsor
Joe plus Codex or Claude loads shared plus Joe-personal
Dell plus Codex or Claude loads shared plus Dell-personal
missing or ambiguous scope is identity_scope_unknown rather than zero

threats.threat: Cross-brain disclosure or personal-rule authority widening
threats.abuse_case: A caller requests the other partner's rules, claims a human sponsor, or uses a personal rule to choose tenant, capability, role, or shared-rule promotion.
mitigations: humanOnly gate follows verified human identity, never sponsor claim
personal rules are non-authoritative for tenant and capability
personal-to-shared promotion remains separately human-gated and audited

threats.threat: Connector, render, and audit disagree or leak rule content
threats.abuse_case: The connector and generated fallback resolve different partner brains or counts, or audit attributes the human as actor and stores personal rule bodies.
mitigations: same-partner connector/render version and count parity gate
agent remains actor and sponsor is separate provenance
audit records scope/version/count/capability but never rule bodies or quotes

acceptance: Every threat has an asset, boundary, abuse case, mitigation, evidence reference, and executable test ID; unresolved threats default deny.
